keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
Delay in match because of an injury Raphael Obermair (Paderborn).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paderborn 0, Eintracht Frankfurt 1. Jonathan Burkardt (Eintracht Frankfurt) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Farès Chaïbi.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Paderborn 1, Eintracht Frankfurt 1. Raphael Obermair (Paderborn) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ruben Müller following a corner.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Nnamdi Collins replaces Ansgar Knauff.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Oscar Højlund replaces Noël Aséko.
Substitution, Paderborn. Deniz Zeitler replaces Gabriel Vidovic.
Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Younes Ebnoutalib replaces Can Uzun.
Substitution, Eintracht Frankfurt. Niko Ilicevic replaces Ritsu Doan.
Substitution, Paderborn. Marvin Pieringer replaces Ruben Müller.
Substitution, Paderborn. Clemens Lippmann replaces Raphael Obermair.
Goal! Paderborn 2, Eintracht Frankfurt 1. Marvin Pieringer (Paderborn) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Paderborn. Rayan Philippe replaces Stefano Marino.
Second yellow card to Elias Baum (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a bad foul.
Deniz Zeitler (SC Paderborn 07) Yellow Card at 80'
